display.purpose: Brand identity — server name, hero headlines, modal titles. Never for body text.

body.purpose: All readable text — paragraphs, labels, descriptions, UI copy.

shadows.name: modal-drop
shadows.purpose: Settings modal depth. The only shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-fast
motion.purpose: State transitions — hover, focus, toggle, border-color changes.

motion.name: ease-mid
motion.purpose: Content transitions — tab switches, panel reveals, thumb position.

motion.name: ease-slow
motion.purpose: Entrance animations — fade-in, slide-in, page-level transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA — join channel, confirm action. Pill-shaped with accent glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6b7aee; color: #fff; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 7px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(107,122,238,0.35); transition: background 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #8b97f2; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(107,122,238,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

components.name: Control Button
components.description: In-call controls — mic, camera, screen share. Column layout with icon + label.
components.css: .ds-btn-control { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 10px; color: #9b9db8; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; min-width: 60px; transition: background 120ms ease, color 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-control:hover { background: #1c1f2b; color: #f0f0f8; } .ds-btn-control.ds-active { background: rgba(107,122,238,0.18); color: #6b7aee; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(107,122,238,0.35); } .ds-ctrl-label { font-size: 10px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Leave call, destructive actions. Red-dim background, fills to solid red on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: rgba(240,77,77,0.15); color: #f04d4d; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 7px 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(240,77,77,0.2); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #f04d4d; color: #fff; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text input with elevated background and accent focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #f0f0f8; background: #1c1f2b; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; outline: none; width: 100%; transition: border-color 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5c5f7a; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: rgba(107,122,238,0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(107,122,238,0.18); }

components.name: Toggle Switch
components.description: Binary setting toggle. Pill track with sliding circle thumb.
components.css: .ds-toggle { position: relative; width: 38px; height: 22px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-block; } .ds-toggle input { opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; position: absolute; } .ds-toggle-track { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: #232638; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-toggle-track::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 3px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: #5c5f7a; transition: transform 220ms ease, background 120ms ease; } .ds-toggle input:checked + .ds-toggle-track { background: rgba(107,122,238,0.18); border-color: #6b7aee; } .ds-toggle input:checked + .ds-toggle-track::after { transform: translateX(16px) translateY(-50%); background: #6b7aee; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(107,122,238,0.35); }

components.name: Channel Card
components.description: Channel list row with icon, name, member count, and join action.
components.html:
#general

3 online
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 14px; background: #14161e; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); transition: border-color 120ms ease, background 120ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); background: #1c1f2b; } .ds-card-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-card-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #6b7aee; box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(107,122,238,0.35); } .ds-card-name { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #f0f0f8; } .ds-card-meta { font-size: 11.5px; color: #3dd68c; margin-top: 1px; } .ds-card-btn { background: #6b7aee; color: #fff; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 7px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(107,122,238,0.35); transition: background 120ms ease; } .ds-card-btn:hover { background: #8b97f2; }

components.name: Badge / Chip
components.description: Status badge, feature tag, or inline label. Pill-shaped with accent-dim background.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; background: rgba(107,122,238,0.18); color: #6b7aee; border: 1px solid rgba(107,122,238,0.35); padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Server sidebar with channel list, user bar, and status indicators.
components.css: .ds-sidebar { width: 220px; min-width: 220px; height: 100%; background: #14161e; border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-sidebar-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 14px 14px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); } .ds-server-icon { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; background: #6b7aee; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(107,122,238,0.35); } .ds-server-name { font-family: 'Space Mono', monospace; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #f0f0f8; } .ds-server-sub { font-size: 11px; color: #5c5f7a; } .ds-sidebar-section { padding: 8px 8px 0; } .ds-section-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #5c5f7a; padding: 8px 6px 4px; } .ds-channel-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; width: 100%; padding: 5px 8px; border-radius: 6px; color: #9b9db8; font-size: 13.5px; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: background 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-channel-item:hover { background: #1c1f2b; color: #f0f0f8; } .ds-channel-item.ds-active { background: rgba(107,122,238,0.18); color: #f0f0f8; position: relative; } .ds-channel-item.ds-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; width: 3px; background: #6b7aee; border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; }

narrative.overview:
Juno is a dark space with points of light. The interface is the void — deep, quiet, receding. Accent colors are the signals: they draw attention to what matters (active channels, speaking indicators, control states) and vanish when they don't. The system rejects the corporate SaaS playbook entirely: no meeting schedulers, no enterprise blue-grays, no sterile professionalism. This is a room for gamers, not a conference tool.

The palette is built on near-black neutrals with cool undertones. The primary accent — a muted indigo — carries the brand identity but is used sparingly, at roughly 10% of any screen. Semantic colors (green for active, red for danger, yellow for caution) are functional, not decorative. The typography pairing of Space Mono (display) and DM Sans (body) creates a technical-but-approachable voice: monospace for identity and labels, humanist sans for readable body text.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first: the interface lives in darkness; light is earned through accent and state
Functional color: every color has a job; no decorative fills or gradient backgrounds
Monospace identity: the brand voice is typographic, not iconographic
Flat at rest: depth comes from tonal layering (bg-base → bg-raised → bg-elevated), not shadows

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary accent (muted indigo) is used on ≤10% of any screen. Its rarity creates focus; overuse destroys it.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Depth is conveyed through the five neutral layers (void → surface → panel → overlay → hover), never through drop shadows.

rules.name: The Semantic Discipline Rule
rules.body: Green/red/yellow/blue are functional signals, not decorative fills.

rules.name: The Mono Identity Rule
rules.body: Space Mono is the brand voice, not the body voice. It appears in the server name, hero headline, modal titles, and channel names. Never set a paragraph in monospace.

rules.name: The Label Restraint Rule
rules.body: Uppercase labels are used for section navigation only. Never for emphasis, callouts, or inline annotations.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The only depth signal is the neutral tonal ramp. Shadows are prohibited except for modal overlays.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Lift Rule
rules.body: Interactive feedback uses border-color and box-shadow (accent glow), never translateY or scale transforms on containers.

dos: Use the five neutral layers for depth. Every surface should be one of: void, surface, panel, overlay, hover.
Keep the accent at ≤10% of any screen. Its restraint is the brand.
Use semantic colors only for their functional purpose (green = online/active, red = error/danger, yellow = warning, blue = info).
Use Space Mono for brand identity elements and DM Sans for everything readable.
Use pill radius (999px) for primary CTAs and badges; medium radius (10px) for containers and inputs.
Animate state changes with the existing transition tokens: fast (120ms), mid (220ms), slow (380ms cubic-bezier 0.16,1,0.3,1).
Support reduced motion with crossfade or instant alternatives for all animations.
donts: Use drop shadows for depth. The system is flat; depth is tonal.
Use the accent color as a background fill. It's a signal, not a surface.
Use semantic colors decoratively. No green section backgrounds, no red callout boxes.
Set paragraphs in Space Mono. It's a brand voice, not a body font.
Use uppercase labels outside of section navigation.
Add gradient backgrounds, glassmorphism, or blur effects to cards or containers.
Use corporate SaaS patterns: no meeting schedulers, no enterprise blue-grays, no sterile professional interfaces.
Use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px as a colored accent).
Use gradient text (background-clip: text). Single solid colors only.
Use the hero-metric template (big number, small label, supporting stats).
